test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

The one who rides horses professionally.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Jockey**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Jockey"** refers to a person who rides horses in races, especially as a profession. (घुड़दौड़ में घोड़ा दौड़ाने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** The jockey skillfully guided the horse to victory in the final race of the tournament. • Hence, **Jockey** is the correct one-word substitution for someone who rides horses professionally. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Jockey**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Rider** (सवार): A person who rides a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle, but not specifically a professional horse racer. • **Example:** The rider slowed down as he approached the busy intersection. • **Groom** (घोड़े की देखभाल करने वाला): A person employed to take care of horses. • **Example:** The groom ensured that the horses were well-fed and groomed before the event. • **Farrier** (घोड़ों के नाल बनाने वाला): A craftsman who trims and shoes horses' hooves. • **Example:** The farrier visited the stable to replace the horse's worn-out horseshoes. **Question:** Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following. The one who rides horses professionally. **The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Jockey.** 1c3:T92c, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., **Taxidermy**.
